info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Fraud Resolution API
info.description: The Fraud Resolution API facilitates the review and analysis of potential fraudulent activities in banking transactions. By leveraging this endpoint, users can retrieve detailed information regarding specific fraud cases identified through the compliance system. This API is designed for compliance officers, risk management teams, and financial analysts who require access to critical data for effective decision-making and investigation. It streamlines the process of addressing fraud-related issues, ensuring that banking operations maintain integrity and compliance with regulatory standards.

get.summary: Retrieve fraud resolution details by ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to query and retrieve detailed information related to a specific fraud resolution by its unique identifier. It is designed to assist in the compliance and investigation processes.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the details associated with a specific fraud resolution operation. The request must include the necessary parameters formatted in JSON to ensure successful processing.

200.description: The request was processed successfully, and the relevant data has been returned.
